name: element_symbols
description: Decode chemical element symbols into element names, with explicitly supplied element-name copy controls.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
symbols='H He Li Be B C N O F Ne Na Mg Al Si P S Cl Ar K Ca Fe Cu Zn Ag Sn Au Hg Pb Ni Co'.split()
names='hydrogen helium lithium beryllium boron carbon nitrogen oxygen fluorine neon sodium magnesium aluminum silicon phosphorus sulfur chlorine argon potassium calcium iron copper zinc silver tin gold mercury lead nickel cobalt'.split()
lookup=dict(zip(symbols,names));items=[];control=[]
for template in ['The chemical symbol {s} stands for the element','Periodic table: {s} is the symbol for','In chemistry, the element with symbol {s} is']:
 for s in symbols:
  a=lookup[s];p=template.format(s=s)
  items.append({'prompt':p,'answer':' '+a});control.append({'prompt':'Reference element: '+a+'. Copy the reference element. '+p,'answer':' '+a})
random.shuffle(items);random.shuffle(control)
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
